why_best: This restrained, luminous arrival mirrors the reflective moment a creator experiences when a render or export successfully finishes.
why_bad: An overly aggressive slide or jarring pop-in would shatter the studio's calm atmosphere and make a high-end authoring tool feel like a noisy web dashboard.
trap: A near-miss will let the final interactive trigger draw attention too early instead of letting the eye travel naturally from top header down to the resolution.
